key_provisions_or_claims: State Department of Education must publish AI guidance for local school systems, educators, parents and students, reviewed annually
Each local school system must adopt an AI policy within 120 days of guidance release and designate an AI coordinator
Department develops a rubric for evaluating AI tools; Morgan State University supports evaluation and certification; procurement must follow State procurement law
AI literacy to be included in workforce preparation standards by June 1, 2027, with teacher professional development
Creates Maryland AI Education Collaborative reporting annually from December 2027; effective June 1, 2026
annotation.summary_en: Maryland Senate Bill 720 (Ch. 634, 2026), the Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act. It requires the State Department of Education to issue AI guidance and an AI-tool evaluation rubric, requires local school systems to adopt AI policies and name coordinators, mandates teacher AI professional development, and creates the Maryland AI Education Collaborative.
